<!-- pr-reviewer: 89b43e04db453e4e70e329e2e204ff702154302c -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The eight guide sections follow the order in issue #1903. The navigation opens the current section and identifies the current page. All 24 moved pages have redirect aliases. The operations overview keeps its URL and heading anchors. Internal links and operation picture paths use the new locations.

Local checks used PR head `89b43e04db453e4e70e329e2e204ff702154302c` and `upstream/main` at `8719d8b7a028f0c93cc78fe32ccbfdf5297a0dca`. The trial merge reported “Already up to date.”

- `python3 -m unittest discover -s site/tests -v`: PASS, 8 tests. These tests check section order, page links, current-page markers, redirects, internal anchors, and operation pictures under a deployment URL prefix.
- `zola build`: PASS with Zola 0.23.6; 42 pages and 10 sections.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run`: PASS; no Rust checks selected.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: PASS; 0 steps and 0 failures.
- Clippy: not applicable. No Rust crates changed.
- `git diff --check upstream/main...HEAD`: PASS.

Requested changes: none.

This change does not affect posted G-code, gouge checks, collision checks, stock simulation, or geometry. Safety-tier review does not apply. No golden files changed. I did not repeat the mutation tests. No files in `crates/ui` changed, so its screenshot requirement does not apply. No dependencies, build scripts, workflow files, or files in `scripts/` changed.

Browser rendering and interactive behavior were not tested. External website links were not checked.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
